vb_textbox.text: The advice I was given suggested that red/purple gnomes give more on average, this seemed true. I recommend picking red/purple, but if they start to give less than +4 mushrooms, try branching out to the other colours for a few rounds (this is almost exactly the advice I was given, which suggested a couple of rounds, which will usually give you a good idea if you're onto a winner). If you're hitting 6+, you're probably doing okay. I found that when the red gnome dried up, sometimes the brown gnome (with the tall mushroom hat) provided very hot streaks of mushrooms, and likewise sometimes the pale green gnome can do the same. Start with Red/Purple as a baseline, but trust your instincts if it seems to dry up. You've got this!
